k510-001.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-001.text: Welcome aboard, explorers. I'm the Commander. We're setting off to answer a question people have asked ever since they first looked at the sky: are we alone?

k510-002.speaker: AVATAR_AI
k510-002.text: Long ago, they say, humanity had a star of its very own. One night, it broke into pieces that scattered across three worlds. No one has seen it since.

k510-003.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-003.text: We're bringing it home. And don't worry: star pieces won't burn or cut you. They're soft, like morning light.

k510-004.speaker: AVATAR_AI
k510-004.text: A uses the left half of the tablet, B the right. Each of you has your own patch of sky.

k510-005.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-005.text: You can join in, or just watch. I'll stay with you either way. That's how great things begin: with everyone aboard.

k510-006.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-006.text: Our star is somewhere ahead. Look at the sky, and hold on tight. Here we go!

k510-007.speaker: AVATAR_AI
k510-007.text: We're leaving Earth behind. I'll remember the way back. That's my job. Yours is to remember that blue.

star-r13a.speaker: CAPITANUL
star-r13a.text: Look at Earth. Everyone you know is down there.

k510-008.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-008.text: So many lights! Even pockets as big as our ship couldn't hold them all. But we aren't looking for every star. Just one.

star-r14a.speaker: AVATAR_AI
star-r14a.text: The first world. Its people have no bodies like ours. They are made of light, and speak through it. Here, words aren't translated. They're felt.

star-r14b.speaker: LUMINA
star-r14b.text: Here, those who love shine. Those who understand become a beacon for others. We see you from far away, travellers. What a lovely glow you have.

k510-009.speaker: LUMINA
k510-009.text: Welcome to Siwarha. Pieces of your star fell here long ago. We kept them among our own. You don't throw light away.

k510-010.speaker: AVATAR_AI
k510-010.text: Look at the large shape at the top. Tap the piece that matches it. Take your time: the light has waited a thousand years. It can wait another minute.

k510-011.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-011.text: You don't need to put your pieces anywhere. They come to the ship by themselves, and fly beside us. Look!

k510-012-C.speaker: LUMINA
k510-012-C.text: All the pieces are flying beside you now. They've found one another again. Thousands of years apart, and they still remember.

k510-012-P.speaker: LUMINA
k510-012-P.text: The pieces you found are flying beside the ship. The others will keep lighting Siwarha. No light is lost. Only borrowed.

k510-012-Z.speaker: LUMINA
k510-012-Z.text: Didn't take anything? Then here's a circle of light to fly with you. On Siwarha, no guest leaves in the dark.

k510-013.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-013.text: Thank you, Siwarha. Our ship has never had an escort of lights before. Next comes the workshop where the pieces find their place.

star-r21a.speaker: AVATAR_AI
star-r21a.text: The second world looks like ours, but it isn't. Here, the planet thinks. Roots are its nerves, rivers its blood. When the wind blows, the forest talks to itself.

star-r21b.speaker: NATURA
star-r21b.text: Here, no one is alone. It's impossible. When a tree hurts, the whole forest knows. When a river laughs, the sea laughs too.

k510-014.speaker: NATURA
k510-014.text: Come into the workshop. Every piece belongs somewhere, like a seed in the soil. If you're missing one, I'll give you one from my garden. That's what gardens are for.

k510-015.speaker: AVATAR_AI
k510-015.text: Place the piece inside its outline. Drag it, or tap the piece and then its place. Every shape knows where home is. Just help it get there.

k510-016.speaker: NATURA
k510-016.text: Each window has two spaces. The pieces stay whole, side by side. Just like you. Nothing shines alone.

k510-017-C.speaker: NATURA
k510-017-C.text: The windows are ready. Every piece in its place, and every place glad to have it. Your star is taking shape.

k510-017-P.speaker: NATURA
k510-017-P.text: The pieces you placed will stay there. There are empty spaces too. That's where the light gets through. Even a gap can be useful.

k510-017-Z.speaker: NATURA
k510-017-Z.text: I'm sending a leaf from my garden to fly with you. A leaf remembers the sun.

k510-018.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-018.text: The star has a body and windows. It needs light inside. You can't find that light or put it in place. You have to switch it on. Let's keep going.

star-r28a.speaker: AVATAR_AI
star-r28a.text: The third world is made of crystal. Its people have overcome illness and distance. They know everything. Calculate everything. Nothing has amazed them in a million years.

star-r28b.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
star-r28b.text: Welcome. Nothing surprises us any more. Nothing hurts us. That's why we like visitors. You still feel wonder. Here, that's become rare.

k510-019.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
k510-019.text: Mann's workshop, at your service! We repair stars, umbrellas... sometimes even shadows. Just in time: a darkness we never calculated is gathering outside.

k510-020.speaker: AVATAR_AI
k510-020.text: Your tablet shows a battery, a bulb and two connectors. Turn the connectors until the wires meet. When the path is complete, the bulb lights up.

k510-021.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
k510-021.text: Follow the wire from the battery, through the bulb, and back. A break in the path? Turn again. The wire is patient. The darkness, a little less so. Let's get to work!

k510-022-C.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
k510-022-C.text: Circuits closed. The star is shining! Take a good look, darkness. We who know everything didn't make this light. They did. The ones who still feel wonder.

k510-022-P.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
k510-022-P.text: Your connections will stay in place. I'll solder the rest. That's what a craftsperson does. The star is shining, and it's coming with you.

k510-022-Z.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
k510-022-Z.text: The wires are still on the table? I'll connect them, with a spark from the workshop. But tell everyone at home: that spark came from us!

star-r34a.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
star-r34a.text: A question for the journey, travellers. If nothing amazes you and nothing hurts you, what stays alive inside you? Don't answer me. Take the question home.

k510-023.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-023.text: A shining star with a travelling tail. Now it's a comet. And it's ours. I'll keep it beside me: in the darkness, it'll see first.

k510-024.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-024.text: We're entering the star tunnel. The tablets can rest. They've done their job. Now our comet will guide us. You lit it just in time.

k510-025.speaker: AVATAR_AI
k510-025.text: Stars flow past us like a river. You can follow our comet or watch the whole sky. From here, every road leads home.

v4-saturn-01.speaker: CAPITANUL
v4-saturn-01.text: The rings! It's Saturn. We're back in the Solar System, close to home. I know the way from here with my eyes closed.

v4-saturn-02.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v4-saturn-02.text: From far away, the rings look whole. Up close, countless pieces of ice and rock. Like our star. Like everything that lasts: many pieces, one light.

v4-saturn-03.speaker: CAPITANUL
v4-saturn-03.text: Goodbye, Saturn. Next comes a world with oceans and clouds, and people waiting for us at the window.

star-r40a.speaker: AVATAR_AI
star-r40a.text: We've seen three worlds. One of light. One alive, like a single soul. One of crystal. Now look at the fourth.

k510-026.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-026.text: Earth! Look how blue it is. We left in the dark. And look at the company we're bringing home.

k510-027.speaker: AVATAR_AI
k510-027.text: Look at the night side. City lights are coming on, one by one. Millions of little lights.

star-r42a.speaker: AVATAR_AI
star-r42a.text: Humanity's star was never lost. It just isn't in the sky. It's in people, one light beside another.

k510-028.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-028.text: And our piece is home again. I'll put it in the window. Perhaps someone down there can see it right now. And feel wonder.

k510-029.speaker: LUMINA
k510-029.text: When you look at the sky, travellers, don't search up there for your star. Look for it in one another. That's where we put it.

k510-030.speaker: AVATAR_AI
k510-030.text: Our journey is over. The screen shows the star and our path through three worlds. Every light there was touched by someone's hand.

k510-031-C.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-031-C.text: Here are the pieces you found, the windows you built, the wires you connected. This is Humanity's Star. Your part of it.

k510-031-P.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-031-P.text: Here are your contributions, and the gifts the worlds added. A star made together. Like every star that lasts.

k510-031-Z.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-031-Z.text: Here's the star we received along the way: a circle, a leaf, a spark and a comet's tail. We'll keep it as a memory. After all, memories are light too.

k510-032.speaker: AVATAR_AI
k510-032.text: The tablets can rest. Watch the star, or whisper to your neighbour. There's just one gift left to choose. The most important one.

k510-033.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-033.text: The star stays where we can see it. It belongs among people. You're coming home, with something new inside you. Welcome home, crew!

k510-034.speaker: CAPITANUL
k510-034.text: Stay at your stations. Your guide will tell you when and where to go. The star will keep watch.
